name: Magica Ride
source:
Haya is a high school student who likes being alone, but she is surrounded by male students every day. One day, a stuffed toy suddenly appears in front of her and takes her to an extraordinary world. The toy is actually the best magician in the world, being transformed into a stuffe toy. Also, evil men run after him and her classmates and teachers get involved in it.... 

"What? Am I a talented magician? Am I the only person who can save my school? So what? I don't care!" She reluctantly follows him and recites a charm... A flash of light surrounds her and she becomes a magician! Will she be able to save her town?

[From Eroge Shop]
translation:
羽矢是一名喜欢独处的高中生，却每天都被男同学们围在身边。某天，一个布偶突然出现在她面前，将她带入了非同寻常的世界。这个布偶其实是世界上最优秀的魔法师，只是被变成了这副模样。邪恶之人也在追捕他，就连羽矢的同学和老师都被卷入其中……

“什么？我是天才魔法师？只有我能拯救学校？那又怎样？我才不在乎！”她不情愿地跟着布偶念出咒语……一道闪光笼罩全身，她变成了魔法师！她能拯救自己的小镇吗？
